text: Hello and welcome back to another week
of iRacing. You join us for a GT3
hot lap of the Nürburgring combined
layout ahead of the iRacing special
event, the Nurb's 24 hours. It's the
ultimate test of endurance racing and if
you want to race the exact setup being
driven in this hot lap, you can go to
our website sambosetups.com.
As well as the race setup, you'll also
get the different variants, so safe, wet
and qualifying. Any questions, let me
know in the comments, but the track
conditions are shown in the overlays.
Also worth noting that after this
initial hot lap, there will be another
one with the driving line on for those
of you that like to leave it on to see
where abouts we're breaking in relation
to that. Enjoy.
